name: cl_Mg8O8
title: (MgO)8 cluster
description: Gas-phase (MgO)8. IR spectroscopy combined with DFT global optimisation (Haertelt et al., PCCP 14, 2849 (2012)) assigns cage-like structures containing hexagonal (MgO)3 rings, not rocksalt cuboids, to (MgO)n with n != 3k. NEP89 instead favours rocksalt fragments: its putative GM (a 3x3x2 rocksalt slab missing one corner MgO pair; Mg 3-5-fold coordinated, Mg-O 1.94-2.31 A, no O-O or Mg-Mg bonds) lies 0.25 eV below the 2x2x4 cuboid and 2.7 eV below a hand-built hexagonal-ring cage.
